title: Without Settings — Integrations the QuickBooks page is not available
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Sign in as a user whose role has every setting except 'Settings — Integrations', at the test location.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Integrations > QuickBooks is not available to this user.
